faqs.a:
Section 104.1. General,
is hereby amended by adding a sentence to the end of the section to read as follows:
"For purposes of enforcement of the I.P.M.C., the code official shall include the
                  code enforcement manager and designees thereof, and the chief of police and designees
                  thereof."
(Ord. No.
4738
, § 12, 9-14-2020)
